headlines.description: — Tennessee Titans rookie quarterback Will Levis needed a moment to reflect after a 20-16 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers on Thursday night – his first loss in the NFL.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans rookie Levis reflects after first NFL loss vs. Steelers

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes said teammate Bryan Cook looked as if he was running the anchor leg of a 4x100-meter track and field relay on his touchdown.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws 2 TDs and Chiefs hang on to beat Dolphins 21-14 in Germany

headlines.description: — Joshua Dobbs hadn't had time to learn his new Minnesota teammates' names in his five days with the team, much less figure out the playbook.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dobbs rallies Vikings to 31-28 victory over the Falcons 5 days after being acquired in a trade

headlines.description: — Deshaun Watson reared back and in one motion signaled his return.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deshaun Watson throws 2 TD passes in return from shoulder injury, Browns demolish Cardinals 27-0

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Aaron Jones finally ended the Green Bay Packers' first-half touchdown drought.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers snap 4-game skid with 20-3 victory over struggling Rams

events.name: Washington Commanders at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Sam Howell was kicking himself.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jartavius Martin's late interception helps Commanders stun Patriots 20-17

events.name: Chicago Bears at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Taysom Hill's production near the goal line put him in Hall-of-Fame company, and defensive back Paulson Adebo had what he considered the game of his life.
headlines.shortLinkText: Taysom Hill's TDs receiving and passing, Paulson Adebo's takeaways lift Saints past Bears 24-17

headlines.description: — The Baltimore Ravens let the trade deadline pass without adding a running back.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens rout Seahawks 37-3 behind defense and Keaton Mitchell's big day

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — Down by four with less than a minute to go Sunday, rookie quarterback C.J. Stroud had complete confidence that he could rally the Houston Texans to a victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stroud has 5 TDs and rookie-record 470 yards passing to lift Texans past Bucs 39-37

headlines.description: — The Indianapolis Colts defense entered Sunday's game reeling after allowing at least 37 points in each of its past three games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kenny Moore's two pick-6s help Colts snap 3-game skid with 27-13 victory over Panthers

events.name: New York Giants at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — The smell of cigar smoke wafted beyond the locker room door, and there was no doubt the Raiders were at long last enjoying themselves.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders roll past Giants 30-6 to give Antonio Pierce a win in his debut as interim coach

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts feigned memory loss. What raced through his mind when a helmet crashed into his already bruised left knee and sent him hobbling toward the sideline — and sent edgy Eagles fans into several anxious moments?
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts shakes off knee injury and leads Eagles past Cowboys 28-23 for NFL best 8-1 mark

headlines.description: — The Cincinnati Bengals showed a national TV audience on Sunday night they are still serious AFC playoff contenders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burrow passes for 348 yards and 2 TDs and Bengals' defense clamps down on Bills in 24-18 win

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Justin Herbert and the Los Angeles Chargers' offense didn't have to do much against the New York Jets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers roll past Jets 27-6 behind Davis' punt return, Ekeler's 2 TDs and LA's sack-happy defense

headlines.description: — The Chicago Bears weren’t too concerned about appearances. All that mattered was that they came out on top.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foreman runs for TD, Bears beat Panthers 16-13 to boost their shot at the top pick in the draft

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Jonathan Taylor ran for a first-quarter touchdown and Mac Jones threw a crucial interception in the fourth quarter and the Indianapolis Colts held on for a 10-6 win over New England Patriots in Germany on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jonathan Taylor runs for early TD and Colts hold off Patriots 10-6 in Germany

headlines.description: — C.J. Stroud keeps showing he is the most exciting rookie quarterback in the NFL since ... well, since Joe Burrow.
headlines.shortLinkText: C.J. Stroud leads another game-winning drive, Texans edge Bengals 30-27 on last-second field goal

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — This latest stop in Minnesota on Joshua Dobbs' seven-year, seven-team NFL journey has become his most eventful experience in less than two weeks.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings top Saints 27-19 for 5th straight win on Dobbs' dazzling half, Winston's late INTs

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — Najee Harris stopped paying attention to the circumstances long ago. Maybe because they almost never change for the Pittsburgh Steelers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Running backs shine early, defense shines late as Steelers slip past Green Bay with 23-19 victory

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Mike Evans sat on the bench, staring at his hands in disbelief.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayfield throws for 278 yards, 2 TDs to help Buccaneers stop 4-game skid with 20-6 win over Titans

headlines.description: — The San Francisco 49ers are Super Bowl contenders once again.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers dominate Jaguars 34-3 to end a 3-game skid and look like Super Bowl contenders again

headlines.description: — The Cleveland Browns have received a lot of ridicule for the massive contract they gave Deshaun Watson last year.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson rallies Browns from 14 down in 4th to 33-31 win over Ravens, tightening AFC North

headlines.description: — Kyler Murray and his surgically repaired right knee were in trouble for a brief moment on the final drive of the fourth quarter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyler Murray leads game-winning drive in return from ACL injury as Cardinals beat Falcons 25-23

events.name: Detroit Lions at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Dan Campbell wanted to make sure his team had the ball until the last second, even if it meant passing up a chance to take the lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff, Lions outlast Herbert, Chargers 41-38 on Patterson's last-second field goal

events.name: New York Giants at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Dak Prescott was told his Dallas Cowboys had just beaten the New York Giants by 72 points combined in the two meetings of the NFC East rivals this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott accounts for 5 TDs, Cowboys rout Giants again 49-17 for 12th straight home win

headlines.description: — Given the opportunity for some more heroics in the closing minutes of the fourth quarter, Geno Smith was nearly flawless.
headlines.shortLinkText: Geno Smith's big throws and Jason Myers' walk-off field goal lift Seahawks past Commanders 29-26

events.name: New York Jets at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — On a night when Josh Jacobs finally ended his 100-yard dry spell, he couldn't quite forget the fumble that gave the New York Jets life late in the game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jacobs rushes for 116 yards as Raiders improve to 2-0 under Pierce, beat Jets 16-12

headlines.description: — Broncos kicker Wil Lutz made good on his do-over field-goal attempt, much like Denver has done in rebounding from one of its most embarrassing defeats in franchise history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lutz is good on second chance with 36-yard field goal in Broncos' 24-22 win over Bills

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson hurt an ankle and lost one of his top targets to a more severe injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens handle Bengals 34-20 after Joe Burrow exits in the 2nd quarter with a wrist injury

headlines.description: — As Dorian Thompson-Robinson sat in the back of a golf cart swiping through text messages overwhelming his phone, wide receiver Elijah Moore slid in to an empty seat behind Cleveland’s rookie quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie QB Dorian Thompson-Robinson rallies Browns to a last-second 13-10 win over Steelers

headlines.description: — Jared Goff was having perhaps his worst game in three years with the Detroit Lions — whose fans even booed him at times — until it was time to win.
headlines.shortLinkText: NFC North-leading Lions rally from 12-point deficit late to beat Bears 31-26 on Montgomery's TD run

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — With Green Bay down to one healthy running back, Jordan Love realized the Packers' hopes likely rested on his right arm.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love's late TD pass lifts Packers to 23-20 victory over Chargers

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Jalen Ramsey had his Miami teammates — even highlight-machine Tyreek Hill — in awe with his game-sealing interception Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Ramsey makes game-sealing interception, Dolphins overcome 3 turnovers to beat Raiders 20-13

events.name: New York Giants at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — Ron Rivera walked back into the locker room, saw Sam Howell sitting at his locker with his head down and asked the young quarterback, “You all right?”
headlines.shortLinkText: Howell has 3 interceptions among 6 Commanders turnovers in their 31-19 loss to the last-place Giants

headlines.description: — Dak Prescott felt the main goal coming into Sunday's game was not to overlook the NFL's worst team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott throws 2 TDs, Bland ties NFL record with 4th pick-6 in Cowboys' 33-10 rout of Panthers

headlines.description: — Trevor Lawrence insisted all week that he had no concerns about Jacksonville's sluggish offense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars bounce back from embarrassing loss with 34-14 drubbing of AFC South rival Titans

headlines.description: — C.J. Stroud was asked if he'd think twice about making certain throws after he was intercepted a season-high three times in Houston's win over Arizona.
headlines.shortLinkText: C.J. Stroud leads Texans to 21-16 win over Cardinals despite throwing season-high 3 interceptions

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Brock Purdy felt it was important for the San Francisco 49ers to get back to an attacking mindset following a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Perfect Brock Purdy throws 3 TD passes to lead the 49ers past the Bucs 27-14

events.name: New York Jets at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — Josh Allen put aside shouldering the blame of getting his offensive coordinator fired this week by placing an emphasis on injecting a little more energy and joy into his on-field performance.
headlines.shortLinkText: Allen and Bills offense reawaken in 32-6 rout of division rival Jets

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Matthew Stafford left the field hunched in pain after a disastrous flea-flicker ended with Stafford taking a massive hit to the chest while throwing an interception with his Los Angeles Rams already trailing by nine points in the fourth quarter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams rally from a late deficit and snap their 3-game skid with a 17-16 win over Seahawks

headlines.description: — Stymied all night by the Minnesota Vikings' smothering defense, Russell Wilson never lost faith in his sputtering offense whose first nine drives ended with Wil Lutz kicking five field goals and Riley Dixon punting four times.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson, Sutton hook up for winning TD as Broncos rally to end Vikings' 5-game winning streak, 21-20

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — The Philadelphia Eagles insisted that their Super Bowl rematch with the Kansas City Chiefs had nothing to do with revenge.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts leads second-half rally as Eagles beat Chiefs 21-17 in Super Bowl rematch

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Jordan Love dropped back and threw deep on his first snap, taking advantage of what the Green Bay Packers thought the Detroit Lions defense would give them.
headlines.shortLinkText: Love ties career high with 3 TD passes, leads Packers to 29-22 win over NFC North-leading Lions

headlines.description: — Dak Prescott and his right guard, Zack Martin, feasted on a turkey leg together on the sideline with six minutes left in the game after the star quarterback's fourth touchdown pass.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bland, Prescott help Cowboys to 13th straight home win with 45-10 victory over Commanders

headlines.description: — After running for two touchdowns and helping San Francisco beat the rival Seahawks for a fourth straight time, Christian McCaffrey was going to enjoy his celebratory meal.
headlines.shortLinkText: Christian McCaffrey's big first half carries NFC West-leading 49ers to 31-13 victory over Seahawks

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Tyreek Hill got into the end zone, found his new wife in the stands and tossed her the ball for a special celebration.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hill's special TD catch and Holland's 99-yard INT return lead Dolphins past Jets 34-13

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — An Atlanta Falcons team looking to snap a three-game losing streak and remain in contention in the NFC South wasn't going to be picky about how it won a game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ridder overcomes 2 interceptions to lead Falcons past Saints 24-15 and into first-place tie

headlines.description: — Days after firing offensive coordinator Matt Canada, the Pittsburgh Steelers showed new life on offense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers pile up season-high 421 yards without Canada, beat Burrow-less Bengals 16-10

headlines.description: — The Tennessee Titans have plenty to clean up with too many penalties and mistakes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Derrick Henry runs for 2 TDs as the Titans hold off Panthers, Bryce Young 17-10

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Jonathan Taylor and Zack Moss ran through the usually stingy Tampa Bay defense Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jonathan Taylor scores twice to help the Colts overpower Buccaneers run defense for 27-20 win

events.name: New England Patriots at New York Giants

headlines.description: — The New England Patriots have a problem at quarterback, and the New York Giants took advantage of it in winning consecutive games for the first time this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants edge Patriots and their woeful quarterbacks 10-7, aided by late missed field goal

headlines.description: — Trevor Lawrence and the Jacksonville Jaguars tried not to make too much of their win over the Houston Texans with plenty of football left this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Lawrence throws for 364 yards, Texans miss late field goal as Jags hold on for 24-21 win

headlines.description: — No, Sean Payton said, he had no idea what a “Scorigami” was.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos' surging defense gets three more takeaways in 29-12 win over Browns

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Kyren Williams cut across the offensive formation on his route before snagging his second touchdown pass of the game, pointing toward the crowd and then taking a bow.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford throws season-high 4 TDs. Rams roll to a 37-14 win over the Cardinals

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Three games in a row without a point in the second half.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes throws 2 TDs, Chiefs rally from 14 down to beat Raiders 31-17

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts walked off the Linc field with his arms extended in celebration as the Eagles crowd — which had booed the team off the field at halftime — went wild in appreciation for one more comeback, one more series of stupefying plays their...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts runs for winning TD in overtime, Eagles rally past Josh Allen, Bills 37-34

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson has been waiting for wide receiver Zay Flowers to have a breakout game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zay Flowers catches and runs for TDs, Ravens force 4 turnovers in 20-10 win over Chargers

headlines.description: — The Chicago Bears finally won one of these up-for-grab games after all those painful finishes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears outlast Vikings 12-10 on 4th field goal by Santos after 4 interceptions of Dobbs

headlines.description: — Trailing Seattle in the fourth quarter, Dak Prescott and the Dallas Cowboys knew there was no way they could extend their NFL record of five consecutive 20-point wins at home to start the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dak Prescott throws for 3 TDs, Cowboys extend home win streak to 14 with 41-35 win over Seahawks
